# World Codex v1.0.0

Initial packaged release for Foundry VTT v13+ / v14-compatible use.

Install manifest:
https://github.com/direbun/world-codex/releases/latest/download/module.json

Highlights:
- Full-screen overlay/window codex UI.
- Bestiary and recipes tabs.
- GM/player visibility controls with sanitized public data.
- Species manager and sample data.
- Actor import support for Generic, D&D 5e, and Fabula Ultima profiles.
- Fabula Ultima attributes, overview stats, and affinity icon display.

Release assets:
- world-codex.zip
- module.json
